name: IC Power Linear Regulator — 3.3V, LDO — DIP
description: Cluster of 4 tier A through-hole 3.3V low dropout (LDO) linear power regulator ICs using DIP-8_W7.62mm footprints.
selection_hints: Select for 3.3V low dropout (LDO) linear voltage regulator requirements in through-hole designs.
Choose from representative tier A parts including LP2951-3.3_DIP, MAX604, MAX882, and MAX884.
avoid_when: The PCB layout requires surface-mount (SMD) components rather than through-hole DIP.
Output voltages other than 3.3V or non-LDO regulator topologies are required.
The required footprint differs from DIP-8_W7.62mm.
